methodology.endpoints: source: force source width; full: anchor-size -> container units -> decoded CSS number -> offset+3*F dependent width; direct: direct CSS arithmetic to same dependent width
methodology.conditions: Each source/full pair lives in separate browser contexts/pages, with matched input/nonce writes and one forced geometry read per output.
methodology.diagnostics: precomputed-font and precomputed-css receive externally prepared answers AND all raw input writes. They cannot be claimed as native arithmetic. Compare their own source/full pair; subtraction from GSUB is not an exact cost decomposition.
methodology.timing: Input writes through forced geometry reads; stimuli, oracle, font loading, correctness comparisons and browser protocol excluded. Mutation/read loops included.
methodology.replication: Exhaustive/full correctness uses a separate browser before timing. Each timed repetition starts a fresh browser and the same small precheck. Different deterministic seed per repetition and width, shared across conditions. Width order rotates and backend blocks rotate by two positions; source/full order alternates each round. Five warmups excluded.
methodology.profiles: Separate pass with independently seeded inputs, five warmups then ten measured rounds; metrics broad browser categories, not pure font CPU. Each profiled output checked.
methodology.inference: Matched source/full difference is the effect of adding reader DOM and dependencies under these fixtures, not an isolated CSS instruction.
